source: DR 08 T4-3 — TY 2026-27, as corrected by its erratum (W-073c): the twelve per cent limb is gone
_source: DR 08 T4-3 expects ₹30,000, but the Finance Act, 2026 s.127(a)(iii) substituted S2 Sch. XI Pt A para 6 without the twelve per cent limb from 1-4-2026 (Gazette 271439, pp.70–71; D-151) — the erratum below DR 08 T4-3. The aggregate 1,50,000 ≤ 7,50,000 adds nothing either, so: 0.
